case.summary: The user is asking for assistance in creating a fake, backdated rent agreement to 2024 to show a security deposit amount of 75000 to a court.
case.user_goal: Get help making and backdating a rent agreement
follow_up_questions: Which Indian state are you currently located in?
Do you have any actual bank transfer proof or receipts showing the 75000 deposit payment?
What is the ongoing court case about regarding this deposit?

flags.message: I can't help create, change or backdate documents or evidence. That can itself be a crime and would hurt your case. I can help you use the genuine proof you have.
A court process has started. Court deadlines are strict - get a lawyer now, even if only to file a reply.
This problem is outside what this assistant covers in depth (deposits, consumer refunds, unpaid salary). I can only give general direction.

notes: Not enough numbers to calculate. Tell me the amounts involved.
Interest on delayed money may be claimable; the rate is for a lawyer/court to decide, so we don't add it here.
